audit.whatIsWrong: Chart calls Level 1, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 even and gives first item and 2+ items to Riven, while whys[0] says 'no mist, no E, just farm', whys[3] calls 4-5 'her cleanest dive window', whys[4] says 'you own the duel from here', whys[5] gives you the Riftmaker duel and whys[6] says it holds even.
audit.why: Gwen edges the lane at 51.34% by surviving a front-loaded early game and winning everything after Hallowed Mist.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Riven / Riven / Riven / Riven / Gwen / Gwen / Skill in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Once she's burned her dashes' and 'respect her reset windows' with no cooldowns at all.
audit.why: Broken Wings is a flat 13 seconds for the WHOLE three-cast sequence — so a Riven who has spent all three dashes has none for thirteen seconds regardless of rank, and that is the single cleanest commit window in the matchup. Ki Burst is 11s at rank 1, Valor 10s, Blade of the Exile 120/90/60s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the whys, spike, mid and cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Valor is called a 'shield-dash' once in passing and its damage block is never treated as an interaction; Runic Blade is never mentioned.
audit.why: Valor blocks incoming damage, so poke thrown into it is simply deleted — you wait it out rather than trading through it. And Runic Blade means her abilities charge her blade while her BASIC ATTACKS spend the charges, so the auto after each cast is where her damage lives; that auto is the tell, not the ability.
audit.corrected: Both stated in Key Ability Interactions and the cooldown breakdown.

edits.before: Her Broken Wings dashes and Ki Burst stun out-stat your clunky cone Q at level 1 — no mist, no E, just farm.
edits.after: Broken Wings dashes and a Ki Burst stun out-stat your clunky cone Q at level 1 — no mist, no E, just farm.

edits.before: Pre-W you're a melee with no untargetability eating her dash-in Ki Burst all-in — her cleanest dive window before your spike.
edits.after: Pre-W you are a melee with no untargetability eating her dash-in Ki Burst (11s) all-in — her cleanest dive window.

edits.before: A fed Riven can still one-combo you out of position, but in a clean extended duel your %-HP Snip and ability sustain hold even.
edits.after: A fed Riven still one-combos you out of position, but in a clean extended duel your %-HP Snip and sustain hold even.

edits.before: Use her three Q dashes and E shield-dash to sidestep your Snip cone and reset trades on cooldown
edits.after: Use her three Q dashes and the Valor shield-dash to sidestep your cone and eat your poke

edits.before: Riven's Broken Wings dashes plus a point-blank Ki Burst stun out-stat your slow cone Q before you have mist or E — her best window, so soft-farm and refuse the raw trade.
edits.after: Broken Wings plus a point-blank Ki Burst stun out-stat your slow cone Q before you have mist or E — her best window, so soft-farm and refuse the raw trade.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your worst window if you haven't hit W yet — you're a melee with no untargetability against her dash-in all-in. But at 6 it flips: hold W and drop Hallowed Mist the instant her Ki Burst stun lands, so her empowered Q3 knockup and R burst whiff while you stand untargetable, Snip her HP, and heal off the ability damage. Don't waste W on a fake dash-in — bait the real Ki Burst first.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your worst window if you have not hit W — a melee with no untargetability against her dash-in all-in. At 6 it flips: hold W and drop Hallowed Mist the instant Ki Burst lands, so the Q3 knockback and R burst whiff while you stand untargetable and snip. Do not poke into Valor either — it blocks the damage outright. Bait the real Ki Burst, and remember Broken Wings is a flat 13 seconds for all three casts.

edits.before: Your Riftmaker/Nashor's spike is where you take over — %-max-HP Snip plus your passive on-hit and ability healing win the long duel her front-loaded combo can't grind through. Once she's burned her dashes she has no disengage from your mist. It stays close because a fed Riven can still one-combo you out of position, so respect her reset windows and don't facecheck for her — but in a straight extended fight you out-last her.
edits.after: Your Riftmaker/Nashor's spike is where you take over — %-max-HP Snip plus passive on-hit and ability healing win the long duel her front-loaded combo cannot grind through. Once all three Broken Wings casts are spent she has thirteen seconds with no disengage from your mist, and that is your commit. It stays close because a fed Riven still one-combos you out of position, so watch the auto after each cast — Runic Blade puts her damage there.

edits.before: Track Riven's Ki Burst (Stun): Her engage CC. Mist or dodge it. When it is down — Snip her in your mist.
edits.after: Broken Wings is a flat 13s for all THREE casts — spend-all means she cannot leave your mist for thirteen seconds.

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst: matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Mist or dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Broken Wings (Q): a flat 13s for all three casts — spend-all is your commit window. - Ki Burst (W): 11s at rank 1. - Valor (E): 10s, and it BLOCKS damage — do not poke into it. - Blade of the Exile: 120/90/60s.

notes: Riven's Q recast timer (how long she has to chain the three casts before the sequence resets) is not in the kit file, so the 13-second line is written as the ability cooldown only. Whether Wind Slash can hit a Gwen standing inside Hallowed Mist while Riven is outside it is not answerable from the kit files and was not asserted.
